propositions: Bare substring containment checks in upstream-URL assertion accept lookalike hosts like 'notpandoc.org' (prefix) and 'pandoc.org.evil.com' (suffix) that do not actionably point at upstream.
CodeQL alert #88 flags the assertion as incomplete URL sanitization despite no untrusted input being present.
Replacing substring checks with scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead `(?![\w.-])` for host boundaries rejects both prefix and suffix lookalikes while accepting valid upstream URLs.

The anchored regex pattern `https?://(www\.)?pandoc\.org(?![\w.-])|https?://github\.com/jgm/pandoc(?![\w-])` must reject 'https://pandoc.org.evil.com' and 'https://notpandoc.org' while accepting real NOTICE mentions.
Module-level compiled regex and assertion update are isolated to the test function; version pins and NOTICE content remain unchanged.
